class: REDUCTION, not expansion -- correcting the direction implied by the goal brief's generic template. Going from the live 0.667 (sell 66.7% at TP1, ride 33.3%) to the ratified 0.8 (sell 80% at TP1, ride 20%) means SELLING MORE at TP1, which REDUCES runner exposure (less size left to the trailing chandelier/structure stop after TP1). This is a risk-reduction direction, the opposite of the goal brief's default assumption that under-applying a sell-fraction increase 'means more runner exposure' -- here the knob that failed to apply was itself the size-down, so today's live shape already carries MORE runner exposure than doctrine intended, not less.
